title: MCP Tool Call Enforcement with Tetragon, Cilium & Hubble
description: Enforce MCP tool-call security across three layers outside the LLM: a Go MCP Approval Gateway with Native MCP Apps UI, Cilium L3/L4 egress lockdown with Hubble UI, and Tetragon eBPF syscall SIGKILL on Kubernetes.
